beats.title: Korean politics and institutions
beats.query: New posts only about South Korean politics, the presidency, National Assembly, prosecutors, martial law aftermath, or major court cases. Skip opinion dunks and quote-tweet pile-ons. Prefer original reporting or official statements.

beats.title: Religious freedom across Asia
beats.query: New posts only about religious freedom, church raids, Family Federation / Unification Church cases in Korea or Japan, detained clergy, or official religious-liberty statements. Skip fundraising and generic sermons.

beats.title: Corporate and economic consequences
beats.query: New posts only about Korea/Japan corporate, FX, supply-chain, sanctions, or investment fallout from political or religious-freedom events. Skip market memes.
